articles.summary: SINGAPORE, March 31, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SAIHEAT Limited (“SAIHEAT” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: SAIH, SAITW), announces the sale of 40MW of cutting-edge liquid-cooling container products to one of the subsidiaries of Bitdeer Technologies Group (“Bitdeer”) (NASDAQ: BTDR).
articles.title: SAIHEAT to Provide 40MW Liquid-Cooling Container Solutions to Bitdeer for the Construction of Its New Data Center
